messages.content: Who is currently the top ranked tennis player?

function.name: sports_team_standing
function.description: Retrieve the current standing/ranking of a sports team in its respective league. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

team_name.description: The name of the sports team.

league.description: The league in which the team participates.

season_year.description: The season year for which the standing is needed. If not provided, current year is assumed. Default: 1994

message.content:
**ATP (Men’s) – World No. 1:**  
- **Novak Djokovic** (Serbia) – He has reclaimed the top spot in the ATP rankings after a brief dip earlier in the year and has been a dominant force on the tour for more than a decade.

**WTA (Women’s) – World No. 1:**  
- **Iga Świątek** (Poland) – She has held the top ranking for most of the season, cementing her status as the leading player on the women’s circuit.

> *Note:* ATP and WTA rankings are updated every Monday based on players’ performances in the preceding week. The information above reflects the most recent rankings available as of the current week.
